machine: Apple M1 Pro / 32 GB / external exFAT-USB SSD / macOS 26

results.label: MEASURED
results.ttft_note: cold — includes first-run Metal kernel compilation; steady-state prefill is much faster
results.verdict: REPRODUCED thesis: a 3B-active 30B MoE is comfortably interactive on this machine, fully resident, ~17 GB.

results.label: MEASURED (after reboot + memory watchdog)
results.cold_load_note: llama load-time metric 1.17 s is warm (page cache); real cold load of ~21 GB from the USB SSD is ~40-50 s wall.
results.swap_safety_detail: free RAM bottomed ~1.7 GB, swap peaked ~2.6 GB, internal stayed ~14 GB free; watchdog never fired; time -l reported 0 swaps. Required a reboot first (reclaimed ~8.2 GB swap); would NOT have been safe before.
results.quality_smoke: Coherent, well-structured Swift, but the debounce implementation is subtly WRONG (captures oldTask but never cancels it; currentTask is a local that doesn't persist across calls -> does not actually debounce). Textbook IQ2 2-bit degradation: fluent + on-topic, correctness bugs.
results.verdict: VALIDATED on speed + memory-safety: an 80B-class model runs resident and interactive (21 tok/s) on a 32 GB M1 Pro via IQ2_XS. OPEN on utility: not clearly better than the clean 4-bit 30B (28.7 tok/s) for correctness-sensitive tasks, given 2-bit quality loss. Needs the full quality suite (brief §15) to settle --best.

machine_memory_safety_finding.label: MEASURED
machine_memory_safety_finding.note: The real resident-model ceiling on THIS machine is set by internal-disk/swap headroom, NOT the 32 GB RAM. The boot APFS container is chronically ~full (user data = 413 GB), so macOS swap cannot grow and the safe wired set is well under 32 GB. CONFIRMED both ways: a ~22 GB model (Qwen3-Next-80B IQ2_XS) was UNSAFE to load when swap was ~94% used (310 MB container free), but SAFE after a reboot reclaimed ~8.2 GB of swap (ran at 21 tok/s, peak swap 2.6 GB, 0 swaps). Practical rule for --best fit-gating on this box: a resident model is safe up to ~22-23 GB ONLY with a fresh swap/disk state (post-reboot or with >=10 GB internal free); otherwise cap ~17 GB. Metal recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize = 26.8 GB is the hard upper bound regardless.
